title: Zorro Ranch breeding program claims

tellings.quote: they claim that they were taken to Zoro Ranch specifically as part of a breeding program where Epstein intended to inseminate them with fetuses that had superior genetics.

tellings.page: section "“I wish I never met him.”", paragraph 8
tellings.quote: Epstein planned to impregnate multiple women at his New Mexico “Zorro Ranch.” The program was modeled on the SS Lebensborn project and was also inspired by the transhumanist ideas of people like George Church (who supposedly regrets his association with Epstein).

related.note: Both are about what was done to women taken to Zorro Ranch. The existing story claims they were to be inseminated in a breeding program; this telling claims their eggs were harvested.

plain: Women say they were taken to Zorro Ranch, the New Mexico property of the financier Jeffrey Epstein, as part of a breeding program in which Epstein meant to make them pregnant with children of superior genetics. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this is what the women claim, and if true it would mean Epstein was running a eugenics project. In his own article "Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell", published 29 July 2025, Jorjani states it in his own voice, "Epstein planned to impregnate multiple women at his New Mexico 'Zorro Ranch'", says it was modeled on the Lebensborn project of the Nazi SS and inspired by the transhumanist ideas of people like George Church, and names no such women and cites no source.

discussion.by: Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell
discussion.text: On the podcast Jorjani gives the breeding program as the claim of women who say they were taken to Zorro Ranch; in the piece he states it in his own voice ("Epstein planned to impregnate multiple women at his New Mexico 'Zorro Ranch.'"), names no such women and cites no source for it.
